title: Dentelle Pear
description: The pear brings a direction the round and oval do not — a pointed tip that leads the eye along the finger. The Dentelle setting follows that line, its arch-shaped prongs linking stone to stone in a continuous lace so the metal reads as decoration rather than grip. Each pear is seated to keep its point true, and the run of fine arches carries the eye from one stone to the next without a break. Set in eighteen-karat white gold, made to fit.
subtitle: The pear's point, caught in a running line of lace.
